preconditions.description: The number of planets N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of Hyperspace™ highways M must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i < v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in highways)
preconditions.description: Each highway must connect two distinct planets within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_j < b_j <= N for a_j, b_j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify two distinct planets within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly Q lines, each representing the minimal number of Hyperspace™ highways for a query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result must be a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of Hyperspace™ highways.
